description: Which countries raised or cut their corporate tax rate between two years, and where does a country rank now?. Compares OECD statutory combined corporate income tax rates across ~146 jurisdictions between two years: who raised, who cut, by how many points, the median shift, and optionally one country's rank and year-by-year path. Computed by Lilambd. Not tax advice. Routes: /years (limit); /answer (from*, to, direction, country, limit). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /years, /answer. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: cit-rate-changes
